summary: Nano-X Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with financial results and a business update, including the appointment of Guy Nathanzon as CFO effective August 1, 2026, replacing Ran Daniel who steps down July 31, 2026. No forced departure is indicated; the change is orderly with a transition period. The filing also notes prior acquisitions, distribution deals, and a restructuring of South Korean operations. As a non-US issuer, Form 6-K is the equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K. The CFO change is a routine succession, not an abrupt activist-driven or scandal-related event, so confidence is medium. To watch: whether the CFO transition signals broader strategic shifts.
